component.name: SelfSteam
component.summary: Add Steam shortcuts with artwork from another device

description.p: SelfSteam is a headless companion that adds non-Steam shortcuts -- streaming services, RetroArch cores, and standalone emulators -- complete with SteamGridDB artwork, from a phone or another computer on the same network, while the target machine stays in Steam's Game Mode. A pairing code shown on screen is the only access control, no accounts needed.

ul.li: Add NSZ support to the ROM picker for Ryubing/Eden Switch shortcuts: pick a compressed .nsz directly and SelfSteam converts it to a real .nsp automatically before launch, no manual conversion needed first

Add an opt-in "Enable preflight" toggle for Ryubing shortcuts, integrating github.com/ScarletPachydermDev/Preflight -- a pre-launch controller check for local multiplayer Switch games that makes sure every paired controller lands on the right player slot before the game starts, installed and kept up to date automatically, with Steam Input enabled on the shortcut automatically since Preflight needs it on to tell same-model controllers apart

The DLC & Updates picker (Ryubing/Eden/shadPS4) no longer sits open all the time -- it now collapses to a small "+" row that expands into the file picker on click and collapses again once a file's picked, matching how every other file picker in the app already behaves
Fix the RetroArch/Emulators tab's own console/emulator picker showing its dropdown arrow in the wrong place (not flush right) whenever nothing was picked yet
Fix picking a different SteamGridDB search result on the URL tab causing a visible full-page flash instead of updating smoothly in place, like every other picker in the app already does
Fix the Couch Mode checkbox, "Install VacuumTube" link, and "Shortcut for X will be added" hint text rendering at three different sizes/styles stacked on top of each other

Add a DLC & Updates picker for shadPS4 (PS4) games: pick any DLC or incremental-update .pkg for a game and SelfSteam installs it automatically -- DLC gets registered the way shadPS4 itself expects, and an update gets merged onto the base game's own install, backing up what it overwrites first
Reopening a shadPS4 shortcut to edit it now shows any DLC/updates already added, instead of starting from an empty list

Removing a DLC file from the picker now actually uninstalls it; removing an update only stops tracking it (shadPS4 has no way to cleanly undo an applied patch's files) -- a warning now explains that fully removing an update means deleting the shortcut and adding it again, which never touches your actual save data

Fix a shadPS4 shortcut's Edit page showing "eboot.bin" as its ROM and guessing a nonsense SteamGridDB search term (a real one matched "eFootball PES 2020" for an actual Bloodborne shortcut) instead of the real game
Fix a shadPS4 shortcut silently failing to install a new DLC/update when just editing an existing shortcut without re-picking the ROM

Fix xemu shortcuts losing their "already installed" BIOS/EEPROM/HDD status on Edit the first time a game's actually been launched -- real xemu rewrites its own config in a format this tool's reader didn't recognize

Fix a manually-added (non-SelfSteam) shortcut's Edit page guessing its SteamGridDB artwork match from its raw launch target instead of its own real name -- a real Flatpak-launched shortcut named "Ryujinx" was matching an unrelated SteamGridDB entry called "Flatpak"

Add a DLC & Updates picker to the Emulators tab for Switch games (Ryubing -- Flathub and both AppImage builds -- and Eden): pick any DLC/update NSPs for a game and SelfSteam registers them with the emulator automatically, no manual setup in Ryujinx/Eden's own UI needed
Reopening a Switch shortcut to edit it now shows any DLC/updates it (or the emulator itself) already has registered, instead of starting from an empty list
Fix the Create button showing an unrelated browser's "Downloading <browser>" label on shortcuts that have nothing to do with the URL tab

Replace the URL tab's browser picker with a curated list (Chrome, Edge, Vivaldi, Firefox, Opera) showing each one's real icon and installing it from Flathub automatically if needed, instead of only ever offering whatever was already installed

Fix Chromium-based browser shortcuts (Edge, Opera) silently never opening under a Flatpak Steam install -- an empty WAYLAND_DISPLAY value was being forwarded and made them try Wayland, fail, and exit instead of falling back to X11
Suggest installing VacuumTube (a dedicated YouTube TV client) right under Couch Mode whenever a YouTube shortcut is being created
Redesign the RetroArch tab's console picker and the Emulators tab's emulator picker with real icons and descriptions (core count / console target) instead of plain dropdown text

Fix a bug where a hard restart (from the auto-update-restart feature) could corrupt the remembered-devices file, silently discarding "remember this device" logins and forcing a fresh pairing-code entry

Extract PS4 .pkg files for shadPS4, which has no PKG-install path of its own -- picking a .pkg as the ROM now extracts it automatically, with "Extracting PKG" shown on the Create button while that runs

Fix shadPS4 shortcuts never actually launching a game -- the real Flathub app wraps a separate launcher CLI with different arguments than shadPS4's own, so every shortcut silently failed to boot until now
Skip DuckStation's first-run Setup Wizard so a freshly-created shortcut boots straight into the game instead of stopping on a config dialog
Add DuckStation (AppImage) to the Emulators tab for PlayStation
Add many more RetroArch cores per console (SameBoy, Azahar, VBA-M, DeSmuME, BlastEm, Kronos, and more), picked via a new two-dropdown console/core selector on the RetroArch tab
Update the RPCS3 first-install heads-up banner to reflect that firmware setup is now automated, with manual steps only as a fallback
Auto-restart into a newer version after a flatpak update -- previously the running server kept serving the old code until manually restarted

Fix RPCS3 firmware installs hanging forever -- RPCS3 keeps its main window open indefinitely after a real install finishes rather than exiting, so completion is now detected by its own "Success!" confirmation instead of waiting for the process to exit
Fully automate RPCS3's first-time firmware setup (its "Welcome" wizard and install confirmation) -- a fresh install now completes with no controller, keyboard, or mouse interaction needed
Show the real original filename for already-installed BIOS/firmware/keys (RPCS3, Vita3K, Cemu) instead of a synthetic description
Fix the pairing-code screen's title sitting an inconsistent distance from the code depending on screen resolution

Fix RPCS3's own firmware-install dialogs never being visible in a gamescope session -- they were genuinely running, just invisible behind Steam's own UI, which looked identical to the install being stuck forever
Add a heads-up banner (with real screenshots of what to look for) on the Emulators tab when RPCS3's firmware isn't installed yet, since Create silently blocks on a dialog on the server's own screen
Block Steam itself from the Apps tab's Flathub browse/search results
Remove itch.io from the curated AppImage list -- it's already a real, installable Flathub app in its own right
Fix the AppImage toggle's info icon sitting too low after an earlier vertical-centering fix overshot
Show the current SelfSteam version at the bottom of the /key settings page
Fix the URL tab's Browser field disappearing entirely when the only installed Flatpak browser was installed system-wide rather than per-user
Fix the pairing-code screen crashing on launch in a gamescope (Game Mode) session -- the code never appeared on screen at all, blocking login entirely

Add an Apps tab: browse Flathub's real catalog (by category or search), or a small curated AppImage list, pick SteamGridDB artwork, and create a Steam shortcut -- installing the app itself happens automatically when Create is clicked
Show a checkmark next to any app that already has a Steam shortcut, and an external-link icon to its Flathub/homepage page
Removing an app that already has a Steam shortcut now also queues that shortcut's removal, applied on the next "Save changes and restart Steam" like every other queued change
Editing an Apps-tab-created shortcut now returns to the Apps tab with that app pre-selected and highlighted, instead of falling back to the URL tab
Fix the Apps tab's own "already installed" section only reflecting whichever page had been scrolled to so far, instead of showing what's actually installed right away
Add a back button to the shortcut-removal confirmation page, matching every other page
Fix dropdown menus missing their arrow indicator everywhere on the page
Add Vita3K .pkg install support (zRIF key) -- installs the package directly from SelfSteam, no separate emulator-side step needed
Fix Vita3K's own --pkg install silently truncating at the first space in the file path, breaking any uploaded .pkg with spaces in its name
Add an optional Font Package slot for Vita3K, separate from the required main firmware
Fix optional BIOS-slot fields (xemu's EEPROM, Vita3K's new font package) showing a misleading required-field asterisk

Auth screen now auto-dismisses after 20 seconds (a draining bar at the bottom, no on-screen countdown) as a reliable fallback for gamepad-only setups -- keyboard dismiss is unaffected; gamepad-button dismiss was investigated further but remains unresolved on real Steam Controller hardware
Fix the pairing-code screen not appearing at all in gamescope sessions (missing DISPLAY in the sandbox)
Show all non-Steam shortcuts in the gallery, not just ones SelfSteam itself created
Add a /custom page for editing non-SelfSteam shortcuts (Target/Start In/Launch options/Name), with automatic SteamGridDB artwork search
Fix Flathub-installed emulator shortcuts routing Edit to the URL tab instead of the Emulators tab
Fix BIOS/keys/firmware files for Flathub emulators silently failing to save -- other Flatpak apps' own config directories weren't actually reachable from the sandbox
Add xemu's missing Hard Disk Image slot (xemu needs 4 files, not 3), with a link to xemu's own free legal image; make EEPROM optional; set Vulkan as the default renderer
Fix xemu's HDD image failing to save game data (its own sandbox only had read-only host access)
Fix EEPROM re-picks silently not saving
Auth screen: exit on a gamepad button press, not just keyboard; tightened the gap between the title and the code
SGDB search box and matches now correctly show as disabled with no API key configured, instead of looking interactive with nothing behind it
Renamed the uploads folder to selfsteam (new installs no longer create a folder named "gridge")
